scenario.title: Sterility failure on Line 3
scenario.description: Batch A-2231 fails its sterility test. A worn gasket from lot G-77 on Filler 3 is the cause, and Line 4 uses the same gasket lot. The Oct 9 cleaning record is missing as a red herring.

twists.description: Batch A-2234 on Line 4 shows a positive EM swab.

redHerrings.description: Oct 9 cleaning record for Fill Room 3 is missing.

hiddenTruth.rootCause: Worn gasket from lot G-77 on Filler 3 allowed contamination during filling.
